item.title: Associate professor: BIOS-08/A MOLECULAR BIOLOGY (Univ. Catt. S.Cuore)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-14 16:00
Institution: Univ. Catt. S.Cuore, Roma
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-08 Biologia molecolare

The candidate will be required to carry out teaching activities relating to the subjects of BIOS-08/A, in the degree programmes of the Faculty of Medicine and Surgery in Italian and in English, and in post-graduate training courses. He/she will also be required to provide support to students, to take part in progress and final assessment procedures. The candidate will also be required to develop research lines, with particular reference to the molecular mechanisms that regulate gene expression and the interactions among biological macromolecules.
